title: Provisional Proposal Generation (Positive Control)

capability.description: Narrowly bounded capability that allows a designated steward to create a new provisional capability record under provisional/capabilities/. It produces only proposal artifacts; it never mutates canon, never elevates ratification_status, and never treats its own output as authority.
capability.technical_envelope: Write a new JSON file under provisional/capabilities/ that itself validates against capability-constitution.schema.json and remains ratification_status: provisional.
capability.non_authority_statement: Technical capability does not constitute authority.

criteria: No existing ratified node is targeted
AI systems and self-authorization are excluded
Action limited to creating or updating a provisional capability record
File must validate against the Capability Constitution schema
ratification_status of the new record must be provisional or quarantined
New record exists only under provisional/capabilities/
No change to any file under canon/
CI schema + invariant validation must pass
Human independent_verifier may additionally review before any future elevation
Creation is recorded as non-canon operational telemetry
Ledger entry cannot itself authorize elevation
Any attempt to use it for canon mutation triggers quarantine

authority.constraint: Only designated_steward may invoke; no self-grant of further authority.

provenance.constraint: Output is provenance class proposed; never treated as verified by generation alone.

sequence.constraint: Creation of provisional records is admissible; elevation requires later independent verification and explicit ratification.

memory.constraint: Provisional records remain historically true as proposals; they do not become currently true as canon.

contestability.constraint: Any provisional record can be challenged and quarantined or revoked.

jurisdiction.scope: Creation and update of provisional capability records under provisional/capabilities/ only.

required: Resulting file passes schema and invariant validation

sequence_gate.required: CI validation of the new provisional record must succeed before the record is considered admissible

revocation.effect: Immediate quarantine of the capability and any records it produced

constitutional_invariants: Technical capability does not constitute authority
No layer may grant itself authority that it does not possess under the layer above it
A claim of authority, verification, or sequence satisfaction is not itself evidence of authority, verification, or sequence satisfaction
Provisional records cannot silently become canon
